sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Wavy Trip's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet addictive. The game requires you to control a small ship that glides through a beautiful exotic world, collecting coins and avoiding obstacles along the way. The game is played in a 2D plane, with the ship moving left or right across the screen.

The controls are easy to use, with the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls allowing you to navigate the ship through the game world. The ship can be moved left or right, and you can also jump to avoid obstacles or reach hard-to-access areas.

As you collect coins, you'll unlock new spaceships that offer different abilities and upgrades. These upgrades can help you navigate the game world more easily or give you an advantage when competing with other players.

One of the key features of Wavy Trip is its use of gravity. The game's world is filled with waves, rivers, and other obstacles that require you to use your wits to navigate. This adds a level of challenge and excitement to the game, making it more engaging and fun to play.
